author: DTrim99
body:
Good question — PE isn't assuming Baltimore; it's deliberately dropping the Maryland county tax entirely, and the two records only look different because of how the local EIC lands.

**The convention.** In the emulator, Maryland county/local income tax is zeroed on purpose. TAXSIM's MD `siitax` is state-only when the input carries no county (the runner comment notes this is verified against the binary — TAXSIM MD siitax matches PE's state-only MD tax to the dollar), and MD's county tax is residence-based, so applying it to a county-less record would systematically overstate MD siitax vs TAXSIM. So the runner sets `md_local_income_tax_before_credits` to 0 for every MD record. (MD is the only local-tax state where this bites — OH/PA/IN/KY/NYC/… need a locality PE isn't given, so they already compute $0.)

So **both** #1132 and #1133 are state-only in PE — no county, and not Baltimore. Rebuilding them without the zeroing, PE's own default county rate is **3.05%**, not the 3.20% on the TaxAct forms.

**Why they look different:**

- **#1133** (high income, no EIC): the county tax is real — 3.05% × 626,236 ≈ **$19,100**, with nothing to offset it — so zeroing it visibly drops siitax from ~52,931 to **33,831** (state-only). That's your "local not included."
- **#1132** (low income, EIC): PE's county tax (3.05% × 7,969 ≈ $243) is **fully offset by the local EIC** (also $243), so it already nets to $0 before any zeroing. Zeroing changes nothing, and siitax stays at **−1,353.83** — which is state tax net of the refundable state EIC. So it *looks* consistent with "local included," but there's no county tax in it either; the local piece just happens to wash out.

So it's actually consistent — county tax is zeroed in both; the low-income record's county tax nets to zero on its own, which is why the zeroing is invisible there.

On "I can do either way": the emulator is currently state-only to match TAXSIM. If you'd rather both sides carry a representative county rate, that's a joint convention change — happy to switch PE's side if TAXSIM adopts a county assumption, but as-is they line up state-only.
